headline: Central Bank of Libya and Finance Ministry Discuss Budget Unification
summary: Libya's central bank governor held technical talks with the finance minister on unifying the state budget. The governor reiterated the central bank's independence while urging inter-agency coordination.
why: Budget unification in Libya is crucial for stabilizing public finances, coordinating national crude revenue distribution, and maintaining macroeconomic stability.

impacts.name: Libya
impacts.why: Libyan state institutions are coordinating to establish a unified national budget.
